claim.quote: After analysis, no events remain in our fiducial region leading to an exclusion curve for spin-dependent WIMP-proton interactions which reaches 0.28 pb at 100 GeV/c^2 a fourfold improvement on our previous work.

name: Low Threshold Results and Limits from the DRIFT Directional Dark Matter Detector

summary.plain: With a lower threshold and better background rejection, DRIFT-IId tightened its limit on spin-dependent dark matter by about four times.
summary.technical: 54.7 live-day shielded run: no events in the fiducial region, exclusion curve for spin-dependent WIMP-proton interactions reaching 0.28 pb at 100 GeV/c^2; a 45.4 live-day unshielded run saw 14 nuclear-recoil-like events at 0.31 +/- 0.08 per day, consistent with ambient fast neutrons from the walls of the Boulby Underground Science Facility.

title: Low Threshold Results and Limits from the DRIFT Directional Dark Matter Detector
why_it_matters: The abstract calls DRIFT-IId the world's most sensitive directional dark matter detector.
